channel.title: Life with God: Audio Meditations
channel.description: Curated audio meditations from Renovaré featuring Nathan Foster and guests.
channel.itunes:author: Renovaré

item.title: Audio Meditation — Only One Thing
item.description: In a new audio meditation, Nathan Foster places David's longing to “dwell in God's house all the days of my life” (Psalm 27) alongside Jesus’ invitation to live in God's kingdom here and now. To be with God and under his rule is something to seek with our whole being, ahead of all else.
item.itunes:author: Renovaré

item.title: Audio Meditation: A Litany of Humility
item.description: We invite you to enter a time of prayer with Nathan Foster as he works through the Litany of Humility’s three movements and expands them with his own meditations. The prayer begins, “O Jesus! meek and humble of heart, hear me.”
item.itunes:author: Renovaré

item.title: New Year Meditation with Vivianne Foster
item.description: Nathan and Vivianne Foster share a meditation for the New Year melding a famous quote by Francis de Sales with the words of Mary from Luke 1 in this bonus episode of Life With God.
item.itunes:author: Renovaré

item.title: Audio Meditation: The Present Moment
item.description: In this audio meditation, Nathan Foster weaves together a selection of beautiful and challenging sayings by 17th-century spiritual director, Jean Pierre de Caussade that invite us to embrace God’s formation deep into our souls.
item.itunes:author: Renovaré

item.title: Audio Retreat: Meditation on Patient Trust
item.description: Today’s podcast is a 13-minute meditation — an audio retreat — on a prayer by the French priest Pierre Teilhard de Chardin. Put on some headphones, find a comfortable spot, and let your soul be quieted.
item.itunes:author: Renovaré

item.title: Meditation on Psalm 131 (Encore Series)
item.description: A 20-minute meditation—an audio retreat—on Psalm 131. Put on some headphones, find a comfortable spot, and let your soul be quieted. This episode is a collaboration with Joshua Banner from The Invitation Podcast (invitationpodcast.org).
item.itunes:author: Renovaré
